boundaries.current_limit: md5sum --tag output and tagged record handling are outside the current checksum manifest grammar and reject before input processing.

boundaries.current_limit: The current Windows capability profile rejects numeric permission mutation and preserves the target file; this is separate from caller authorization.
boundaries.unlock_condition: Enable only with released public Windows permission semantics and independent Native/Wasm Windows mode/effect/error observations. Do not infer support from POSIX chmod or file-access authorization.

boundaries.current_limit: Symbolic-link creation is enabled only for POSIX in the current platform capability table; Windows ln -s rejects before creating or replacing the link.
boundaries.unlock_condition: Enable a Windows subset only after released public API/host creation and target-type/privilege/error behavior is identified and independent Native/Wasm Windows link/referent/replacement observations pass. A Native mv rename fix is not proof of ln creation support.

boundaries.current_limit: Bash-style array assignment is outside the bounded shell grammar and rejects as a syntax error before execution.
boundaries.unlock_condition: Keep this syntax rejected unless the supported shell grammar is deliberately extended with implemented array assignment/expansion/error semantics and independent declared-oracle tests. This is a language-profile restriction, not evidence of a missing async API.

boundaries.current_limit: tail supports following the already open descriptor but rejects -F path-follow/reopen because reliable replacement detection lacks public file identity.
boundaries.unlock_condition: Require released public file identity plus Native/Wasm rotation/recreation/truncation/missing/unreadable/path-race and pinned GNU follow-name observations. Reopening a path alone does not prove replacement.

boundaries.unlock_condition: Implement checked forward reads/discards with empty/short/EOF/error-prefix and byte/status differentials. Only backward or end-relative positioning requires a proven seekable input or explicit spool; do not wait for a new seek API merely to support forward skipping.
